rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a response, including an emoji reaction on a social-media post.

example.english: Your photo got lots of reaction.
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 soeng2 jau5 hou2 do1 faan2 jing3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a chemical transformation rather than a person’s or user’s response.

example.english: Mixing these two substances causes a chemical reaction.
example.traditional: 呢兩種物質混埋就會有化學反應。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zung2 mat6 zat1 wan6 maai4 zau6 wui5 jau5 faa3 hok6 faan2 jing3
